item.skyabyss.socket_shard.desc: Titan powder holding the power of %2$s. Socket it into gear. Dropped by foes of the land.
item.skyabyss.aspect_core.desc: A skill rewrite drawn out of heroic-or-better gear. Imprint it on a rare or epic weapon or armor piece (one per item).
item.skyabyss.skill_rune.desc: A rune for a single skill. Socket it. Only one rune per skill works.
item.skyabyss.skill_rune.cap: Total modifier power caps at x2.0
gear.skyabyss.hollow: Its rewrite was drawn out; only the mark remains
gear.skyabyss.generation_next: %1$s more generation(s) until a keepsake trait opens
message.skyabyss.gear_generation: %1$s piece(s) of gear gained a generation through the rebirth.
gui.skyabyss.forge.inscribe_help: Place gear. Extract heroic+ rewrites, imprint cores on rare/epic, socket shards and runes. Materials: left.
gui.skyabyss.forge.inscribe_no: Only rare-or-better weapons and armor with affixes qualify.
gui.skyabyss.forge.extract_none: Only heroic-or-better gear with a skill rewrite can be extracted.
gui.skyabyss.forge.extract_hollow: This item's rewrite was already drawn out.
gui.skyabyss.forge.extract_destroy_hint: Destroy the item and take only the Remnant Core.
gui.skyabyss.forge.extract_keep_hint: The item stays; only its rewrite is hollowed out (affixes and upgrades remain).
gui.skyabyss.forge.imprint_rare_only: Cores can only be imprinted on rare or epic weapons or armor.
gui.skyabyss.forge.imprint_help: Place an Remnant Core in the material slot.
gui.skyabyss.forge.insert_help: Put a powder or a rune in the material slot.
gui.skyabyss.forge.insert_dup: This item already has a rune for that skill.
item.skyabyss.powder.combine: Use while holding %s of the same tier to make one of the next tier
message.skyabyss.powder.need: You need %s powders of the same tier
powder_art.skyabyss.stone.weapon: a shockwave around the struck foe that staggers
powder_art.skyabyss.wind.weapon: pulls nearby foes in and lifts them
powder_art.skyabyss.tide.weapon: heals 20% of the damage dealt, shared with people nearby
powder_art.skyabyss.ash.weapon: burns, then bursts when the fire runs out
powder_art.skyabyss.bone.weapon: the foe takes more damage for 4 s
powder_art.skyabyss.bone.armor: returns 30% of the damage taken to the attacker
item.skyabyss.powder.art_rule: Works when one item holds this powder at tiers adding up to %s or more (weapons every 4th hit, armor once per 8 s)
gui.skyabyss.forge.combine_hint: Turn %s powders of the same tier in the material slot into one of the next tier
gui.skyabyss.forge.combine_help: Put %s powders of the same tier in the material slot to combine them into the next tier
gui.skyabyss.forge.powder_help: Place gear to socket powders or runes. Put a powder in the material slot and press Socket. Removing is free and the powder keeps its tier.
gui.skyabyss.forge.powder_no: This item has no sockets. Uncommon or better weapons (bows too), armor and shields have them.
gui.skyabyss.forge.remove_hint: Remove (free; the powder keeps its tier)
